description: Fetch the complete detail record for one California state grant opportunity by its California Grants Portal ID (PortalID). Returns the full narrative purpose and description, eligible applicant types and eligibility notes, geography served, funding source, whether matching funds are required, estimated funds available and per-award amounts, funding method (reimbursement vs advance), the open date and application deadline, whether electronic submission is accepted, agency contact information, and links to the official grant page and agency site. Use after ca_search_grants to read the full terms of a specific California state grant.

portal_id.description: The California Grants Portal ID from a search result, e.g. "189801".

name: ca_get_grant
title: Ca Get Grant
